content.text: hey I want to work on yyot from chatgpt mobile app using codex. guide me real quick
I’ll use your `$i-have-adhd` style and check the quickest supported setup for working on yyot from your phone.

**On your Mac, open the desktop app → Settings → Connections → Control this Mac.**

1. Click **Set up** or **Add** to display a QR code.
2. Scan it with your phone and complete pairing using the **same ChatGPT account and workspace**.
3. In ChatGPT mobile, open **Codex** or **Remote**, depending on your app version.
4. Select your Mac, open **yyot**, and continue an existing chat or start a new one.

Your Mac runs the code against your local yyot files; your phone sends prompts and approvals. **No GitHub upload is needed.**

Keep the desktop app running and your Mac awake, online, and plugged in. For a MacBook, leave the lid open. [Official OpenAI guide](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/remote-connections)

**Start by opening Settings → Connections on your Mac.**
